questions.prompt: Look at Owen now. He ____ a suitcase.
questions.evidence: Owen is pulling a suitcase.
questions.explanation: now 和 Look 表明眼前动作；he 对应 is，再接 pulling。

questions.prompt: The friends ____ on the platform right now.

questions.prompt: They are not ready to get on. Choose the correct sentence.

questions.prompt: Choose the question about an action happening now.
questions.evidence: Are they waiting here?
questions.explanation: 把 are 放到 they 前；不写 Do they are。

questions.prompt: The commuter usually ____ this way every weekday.
questions.evidence: The commuter travels every weekday.
questions.explanation: 日常习惯用一般现在时；commuter 单数，动词加 -s。

questions.prompt: Today, instead of going to work, she ____ her sister.
questions.evidence: Today she is visiting her sister.
questions.explanation: 这里描述今天的临时行程；she 与 is visiting 搭配。

questions.prompt: I ____ by train every Monday.
questions.evidence: I travel on Mondays.
questions.explanation: I 作主语的一般现在时用原形 travel，不加 -s。

questions.prompt: We have arranged tomorrow’s meeting. Our friend ____ us at the station tomorrow.
questions.evidence: Our friend is meeting us at the station tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 双方已约定的未来安排可用现在进行时；tomorrow 不代表这句只能用 will。

questions.prompt: According to the published timetable, the service ____ at eleven.
questions.evidence: The service leaves at eleven.
questions.explanation: 固定时刻表用一般现在时，service 是单数，leaves 加 -s。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the train’s timetable.
options: The train is arrive at twelve ten.
The train arriving at twelve ten.
The train arrive at twelve ten.
The train arrives at twelve ten.
answers: The train arrives at twelve ten.
questions.evidence: The train arrives at twelve ten.
questions.explanation: train 单数，一般现在时 arrives；不能漏主谓一致或混入 be。

questions.prompt: The train ____ late at the moment.
questions.evidence: The train is running late.
questions.explanation: 眼前状态用 is running late，run 的 -ing 双写 n。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct -ing form of make.
questions.evidence: make → making
questions.explanation: make 末尾不发音的 e 去掉，再加 ing。

questions.prompt: Owen is ____ in an unreserved seat now.
questions.evidence: sit → sitting
questions.explanation: sit 的短元音后单辅音要双写 t，再加 ing。

questions.prompt: Choose the normal expression for a fact you know.
questions.evidence: I know the platform.
questions.explanation: know 在这里表示知道这一状态，通常不用进行时。

questions.prompt: Our luggage ____ beside the seat.
questions.evidence: Our luggage is here
questions.explanation: luggage 不可数，按单数一致用 is，不能因中文“行李很多”改为 are。

questions.evidence: three pieces of luggage
questions.explanation: 用可数的 pieces 表示件数；luggage 本身不加 -s。

materials.title: 正在发生、日常习惯与已安排的行程
materials.instructions: 先比较三个时间含义，再独立选答；订正时说清主语、时间线索和动词形式。
materials.passage:
1. 正在发生：am / is / are + 动词-ing。Owen is pulling a suitcase. Jade is checking the display. 主语复数用 are：They are waiting on the platform. 否定把 not 放在 be 后：They are not boarding yet. 问句把 be 提到主语前：Are they waiting here? 不再添加 do。

2. 日常习惯用一般现在时：The commuter travels every weekday. I travel on Mondays. 第三人称单数加 -s；today / now 发生的临时活动常用现在进行时：Today she is visiting her sister. 注意判断句意，不能仅凭一个时间词套公式。

3. 已确定的未来安排也可用现在进行时：Our friend is meeting us at the station tomorrow. 这里不是说她此刻已在见我们，而是双方约好的安排。与前课 going to 表示意图相联系；本课区分安排与眼前动作。

4. 列车时刻表常用一般现在时：The service leaves at eleven. The train arrives at twelve ten. 说当前延误状态则可用 is running late。 The train is running late. 时刻表时间和眼前动作不同。

5. 拼写：wait → waiting；make → making（去不发音的 e）；sit → sitting（双写末尾辅音）。不要写 is wait、is makes 或 is siting。

6. know、need 等表示状态的动词在本课含义下用一般现在时：I know the platform. We need a valid ticket. 不写 I am knowing。luggage 是不可数名词：Our luggage is here，不能写 three luggages；可说 three bags 或 three pieces of luggage。

materials.title: A Journey with a Change of Plan
materials.passage:
Jade and Owen are meeting at the central railway terminal on Saturday morning. Their destination is a coastal town where a friend lives. The timetable lists a departure at 9:20 and an arrival at 10:10. They have chosen an express service because it makes fewer stops. The fare is higher than the fare for the slower service, but the shorter journey gives them more time with their friend.

Owen reaches the station first. He is pulling a small suitcase, while Jade is carrying their lunch. They keep their luggage close because the main hall is busy. A commuter beside them explains that she travels this way every weekday. Today she is visiting her sister instead of going to work. Each passenger needs a valid ticket before entering the platform area. Jade has a seat reservation in carriage three, but Owen has a ticket without a reserved seat.

At 9:05, they hear an announcement. There is a twenty-minute delay because workers are checking part of the track. The train will depart from platform six instead of platform four. Jade checks the display before they move. The change matters because another train is already waiting at platform four. It goes inland, in the opposite direction from their destination.

The friends discuss a connection through West Junction. That option would require a transfer, and the second train might leave before they reach it. They decide to stay with their direct service. Staff do not plan to cancel it; they expect the track check to finish soon. Jade sends their friend a message explaining that they will arrive later than planned. Their friend replies that she is meeting them outside the station and can wait.

When boarding begins, Owen asks the conductor whether he can sit beside Jade. The conductor checks the reservation display and finds an unreserved seat in the same carriage. He also points out the emergency information beside the door. They board carefully, put the suitcase in the luggage space and keep the aisle clear. Jade is reading the updated arrival time, while Owen is checking that they have all their bags.

The delay has changed their plan, but it has not ended their trip. They have checked the platform, chosen a workable route and told their friend what is happening. Before leaving home next time, they will check for travel updates as well as reading the printed timetable.
materials.instructions: Read the passage and answer each question. Use the stated word limit for short answers.

materials.title: Which Train Should We Take Now?
materials.transcript:
Jade: I'm at the ticket hall. Are you waiting on platform six?
Owen: No. The announcement has changed our platform to eight. I'm standing beside the stairs.
Jade: Is our express train still leaving at ten thirty?
Owen: It is running fifteen minutes late. The display now says ten forty-five.
Jade: Did the announcement explain the delay?
Owen: Yes. Staff are checking a signal beside the track near North Junction. They cannot say when it will be ready.
Jade: I don't want to cancel our journey, but we will miss our connection at North Junction. Shall we use a direct service instead?
Owen: Yes. The conductor says the eleven o'clock service goes directly to the coast. We won't need a transfer.
Jade: Is our ticket valid on that service?
Owen: Yes, but our seat reservation is not. We can ask for new seats at the desk.
Jade: I'd like a seat near the luggage space. This suitcase is heavy.
Owen: There are two seats together in carriage five. The fare is the same, so we don't need to pay extra.
Jade: Good. What is the new arrival time?
Owen: Twelve ten. I'll message our friend now. She is meeting us outside the station.
Jade: What if she gets there early?
Owen: The terminal has an indoor waiting room. She can wait there and come outside when our train arrives.
Jade: Thanks. I'm buying some water before we board. Do you want anything?
Owen: Just water. Please meet me by the stairs at ten fifty. We should allow ten minutes to get to the right carriage.
Jade: All right. I'll check the platform display again before I come.
materials.instructions: Listen to Jade and Owen. Choose ONE answer. Use the details in this recording, which differ from the reading passage.
